evidence.title: InsufficiencyBench: Evaluating LLM legal advice on underspecified user queries

summary: Researchers unveiled InsufficiencyBench, a benchmark that evaluates how large language models respond to underspecified legal queries. The study reveals notable shortcomings in current LLMs' legal advice, underscoring the need for improved evaluation and model robustness.
title: New InsufficiencyBench Benchmark Tests LLMs' Ability to Provide Legal Advice on Vague Queries
